description: A low pass gate: one control opens a two pole filter and an amplifier together, so the signal gets brighter as it gets louder

params.text: Holds the gate open by a fixed amount, moving the corner between 100Hz shut and 24100Hz fully open and the level with it; it comes up fully shut
Sets how fast a strike dies away, a time constant of 1 second at its lowest setting and 0.125 seconds at its highest

inputs.text: Multiplies the level knob, 10V giving the knob's own setting and 0V shutting the gate; a patched cable sitting at 0V silences the module whatever the knob says
Opens the gate fully on each rising edge above 1V, after which it decays at the rate the decay knob sets

outputs.text: The filtered signal scaled by how far the gate is open

notes: the level knob comes up fully shut, so a new Lyra passes nothing until you raise it or send a strike

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads unity, leaving the knob alone.
inputs.2:
unipolar · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
